params.body:
Schoutteet does not rent out vehicles; it buys them over or takes them in trade. The site said otherwise in a service, the home page and the translations.

## What changes

- The `verhuur` service becomes **Overname en inruil** (anchor `#overname` on /diensten): buying a vehicle over or taking it in trade, with a button to the Aankoop page ("Vraag een bod op uw voertuig").
- `/diensten/verhuur` (and the localised variants) redirect 301 to `/diensten#overname`, through `Services::RENAMED`.
- Every other mention of rental is gone, in Dutch and in `lang/{en,fr,de,es}.json`.
- Home hero: the text now says what the company does, buying and selling commercial vehicles plus the service around them (trade-in, financing, workshop, tachograph as approved installer), on one address in Oudenburg, with a personal approach. "Sinds 1970" stays as the eyebrow.
- The page `<title>` stays on the vehicles it sells.

## Checked

- `php artisan test`: 48 passed, including the 301 from the old URL (nl, fr) and a check that no services page in any locale, nor the home page, mentions rental.
- `vendor/bin/pint --test`: clean.
- No em dashes in the new copy.
params.title: Overname and trade-in instead of rental, home hero on buying, selling and service
